reason: I always leave my pills at home and I travel a lot, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box it is cheap enough to just try once.
objection: I don't know if I'll actually feel a difference, and I'm not thrilled that it's made in China, even with the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report wasn't really on the page or the batch number didn't match, I'd pass. A visible price above about $35 for the first box would also flip it.
